transcript: If Maybe Happy Ending on Broadway isn't on your radar yet, it needs to be. I went last night with Paul and my sister and all three of us loved it. Starring Darren Criss and Helen J Shen, Maybe Happy Ending is a new musical about two retired helperbots who go on an adventure together. It is a romantic, quirky, and intimate piece and has some of the most stunning and creative visuals I've seen on a Broadway stage in recent memory. The integration of the set, projection, and lighting designs is remarkable, and coupled with the amazing direction by Michael Arden, the show is quite cinematic. Darren's and Helen's helperbot characterizations are delightful and at times, very funny, and their chemistry is really good. Honestly, the whole experience from the script and the score to the performances and the production value was really enjoyable and somewhat unexpected, with this being a completely original musical not derived from any preexisting IP. So if you're at all concerned about a shortage of innovation on Broadway, go see Maybe Happy Ending, then get back to me. With that, another playbill for my collection.
reasoning: Strong enthusiastic recommendation with specific praise for multiple elements (visuals, performances, direction, originality). Uses superlative language like 'most stunning' and 'remarkable' while clearly stating 'all three of us loved it.'
